name: Dinofurie
storyline:
Dinofurie is a fast-paced multiplayer dinosaur battle royale set on the mysterious island of LaBBany, an isolated land lost in time. For millions of years, this forgotten ecosystem thrived in secrecy—until 66 million years ago, when the impact of the Chicxulub asteroid reshaped the world and turned survival into a brutal contest. The skies darkened, the environment became hostile, and only the strongest endured. Now, in a world already on the brink of extinction, dinosaurs fight relentlessly to become the last one standing.

Players control a diverse roster of dinosaurs, each with unique abilities, combat styles, and roles in a chaotic battlefield shaped by dynamic storm zones and dangerous terrain. Master directional attacks, grappling mechanics, bleed and venom effects, and stamina management to outplay rivals in intense multiplayer battles. In LaBBany, herbivores and carnivores alike are formidable contenders—because there is no escape from extinction, only conflict.
summary: Dinofurie is a thrilling multiplayer battle royale where dinosaurs clash in intense survival battles. Choose from a diverse roster of prehistoric creatures, each with unique abilities and playstyles, and fight for dominance in a vast, dynamic world.
